note.question: How does nudging reduce user participation and privacy harm and sometimes improves social welfare?
note.overview: This paper studies a novel privacy concern, i.e., peer disclosure of sensitive personal information in online social communities. We model peer disclosure as the imposition of a negative externality on other people. The model encompasses the benefits of posting information, positive externalities in the form of recognition and entertainment benefits due to others’ sharing of information, and heterogeneous privacy preferences.
